exposure: maternal oxygen administration during vaginal delivery
non-reassuring fetal status (NRFS) during vaginal delivery
oxygen (10 L/min) supplied by a facemask
cohort: 250 singleton pregnancies requiring operative vaginal delivery or emergency cesarean section due to non-reassuring fetal status during vaginal delivery
finding: Maternal oxygen administration during vaginal delivery for non-reassuring fetal status did not significantly affect umbilical artery gas measurements or neonatal outcomes.
